ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 75% high-intensity pixels (white ventral field) to 25% low-intensity pixels (black perimeter and internal markings).
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Centralized high-intensity white field bisected by a low-intensity black vertical stripe at the peduncle junction. Distal tips show dense black mottling, specifically a complex 'fingerprint' pattern on the far left tip. Scattered dark circular pixel clusters of variable diameter are distributed across both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped central depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 65 degrees and a vertical depth reaching the peduncle transition.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency irregular serrations; notable macro-notches (peaks and valleys) visible on the medial third of the right lobe and distal half of the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave-to-convex transition with lobes tapering towards pointed distal tips; right lobe exhibits a steeper upward sweep relative to the median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular dark pixel clusters (diameter 10-30 pixels) detected primarily on the inner right lobe and lower central regions.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several distinct vertical black linear streaks (rakes) crossing the white field, most prominent on the interior left lobe and the border regions.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular loss of material along the trailing edge topography suggests mechanical trauma; multiple small circular pigmented lesions across the white field.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly unique, high-contrast reticulated black pattern on the extreme far-left tip of the fluke lobe.
